original_target.title: Uniqueness of the Brownian coagulation similarity profile

scope_comparison: Actual1510.03361v3 introduction equation1.2 identifies Brownian kernel and distinguishes its general uniqueness question. The theorem assumes K=2+epsilon W with sufficiently small epsilon. The full Brownian ratio terms at coefficient1 are not a small perturbation covered by the result. Time-dependent coagulation/breakage uniqueness and multiplicative/constant kernels differ.
